title: .LLab Creative Estate Mapping™
intro: Identify what should be captured, embedded, transferred, and sustained in your creative estate.

nodes.prompt: Using your Body of Work Inventory™ (or starting fresh), what is the full scope of what exists?
Where is it stored, and is it backed up anywhere durable?
What do you actually own outright (copyright, trademark, master files) versus license or share?
Is there any work whose ownership is unclear or undocumented?
Who are the people (collaborators, platforms, a gallery, a publisher, an agent, a community) this estate depends on?
Who would need to be contacted, and what would they need to know, if you were unavailable for six months?
Which of your operating systems (from The .LLab Creator Operating System™, if you have it) would keep running without you actively managing them?
CAPTURED — what needs to be documented that currently exists only in your head:
EMBEDDED — what needs to become a written process, not a personal habit:
TRANSFERRED — who needs access, instructions, or rights they don't currently have:
SUSTAINED — what needs ongoing maintenance (renewals, backups, relationships) to keep working:

closing.prompt: The one change we will make next, who will own it, and by when:
